newsitem.title: UK: Grand Met up after Kleinwort, UBS support.
newsitem.headline: Grand Met up after Kleinwort, UBS support.

text.p: Shares in Grand Metropolitan Plc, the Burger King to Smirnoff vodka food and drinks group, rose on Wednesday after positive comment from analysts at Dresdner Kleinwort Benson and UBS, dealers said.
At Kleinwort, analysts advised switching into the stock and out of Allied Domecq Plc while at UBS analysts repeated a "buy" recommendation.
Analysts at both brokerages were not immediately available for comment.
The stock was up 7p or 1.45 percent at 490 by 1414 GMT, near its year's high of 504p set on March 20. Allied was down 2-1/2p at 441-1/2.
